title: pgrls test protocol conformance manifest
description: Schema for tests/protocol/manifest.json. A future TS / Go port loads the same manifest and is 'v1-conformant' iff every case passes against the schema.sql + seed.sql fixture.

protocol_version.description: The Layer 1 contract version this manifest exercises. Bumps in lockstep with docs/pgrls-test-protocol.md.

fixture.description: Paths (relative to the manifest) of the schema and seed SQL files. Applied in admin context before any case runs.

cases.description: Each case runs in a fresh per-test transaction with a single SAVEPOINT-scoped role + claims block.

name.description: Human-readable case identifier. Used as the pytest parameter id.

role.description: Postgres role name to switch to via SET LOCAL ROLE.

claims.description: JWT claims object set into the request.jwt.claims GUC. Use null to skip the set_config call entirely (an actor with no claims at all). Use {} to set the GUC to the empty JSON object (an actor with claims but none of the keys the policy reads).

kind.description: Which assertion helper drives this case.

sql.description: Statement to execute. For 'assert_silently_dropped' the SQL must contain RETURNING.

expect.description: Required for 'fetchall'; a list of column→value dicts the query must return. Forbidden for the assert_* kinds (those have implicit pass/fail semantics).
